text:
alex: :rotating_light: Seeing a sudden spike in 502/503 from Private VPC customers hitting our ILB cross-region path. Starts ~11:12 UTC. Alert: ilb-proxy-5xx-rate. Not sure if it's origin or something in GCP networking.
maya: Confirmed. Dashboards show control-plane API errors for forwarding-rule updates to eu->us ILBs. Errors look like 500 from a third-party observability API we call during route validation.
jamal: Observability vendor (obsco) incident? I see elevated errors when we POST route-check to https://api.obsco.example/status around the same time.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0452. Pager sent to #oncall (tia_oncall).
tia_oncall: I'm on it. Pulling logs and scope. Which customers?
alex: Preliminary: 7 Private VPC tenants in eu-west1 with cross-region backends to us-central1. Symptoms: 502s during long tail requests, degraded health checks, some control-plane retries causing transient route flaps.
maya: Stack traces show failures when our control-plane attempts to validate egress IPs via obsco. Example response: ```json
{
  "error": "upstream 502",
  "code": 502
}
```
jamal: GCP ILB itself showing normal backend health, but our controller's apply loop is retrying because obsco returns 5xx for metadata checks. That triggers reprogramming, which correlates with route propagation delays.
tia_oncall: Mitigation plan: 1) disable obsco validation for Private VPC control-plane (fallback=true) 2) pause non-critical forward-rule updates 3) increase canary to local routing for affected tenants. I'll try step 1 now.
eng-sre: +1 to disable. Need exact flag flip command. Keep me posted before any rollbacks.
jamal: Command to set fallback: ```bash
curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood.internal/config/validation -d '{"obsco_validation": "fallback"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
ops-bot: Runbook check: control-plane validation fallback documented under /runbooks/ilb-crossregion-deps.md :eyes:.
tia_oncall: Executed config flip. Response: `{"status":"ok","changed":true}`. Rolling limited restart of controller pods to pick up config.
deploy-bot: Rolling restart started for control-plane pods: cp-controller-1..3.
maya: Observability vendor status: https://status.obsco.example.com shows "Partial outage - API validations failing intermittently". ETA unknown.
alex: Customer impact assessment: - API latencies up ~300ms on average for cross-region requests; error rate spiked to 3.2% at peak (from 0.05%). Affected customers: tenant-53, tenant-88, tenant-101 (all Private VPC, cross-region). CS notified.
customer-success: Notified the three tenants with templated message and mitigation steps. Will escalate if they see ongoing errors.
jamal: After fallback enabled, control-plane churn reduced significantly. Still seeing some 502s from in-flight changes. Healthcheck flaps decreased by ~80%.
tia_oncall: Next: open temporary routing policy for eu-west1-local-first for the three tenants to avoid cross-region hairpin while vendor is flaky. Applying policy now.
alex: Policy applied to tenant-53, tenant-88. tenant-101 queued (rate-limited).
eng-sre: Double-check that policy doesn't violate privatevpc isolation rules. I reviewed ACLs — safe for the short window.
maya: Also adding prefix KV cache bypass so we don't rely on control-plane for transient consistency. Small config snippet: ```yaml
cache:
  prefix_kv: disabled
  ttl: 30s
```
ops-bot: Pager: follow-up required: contact obsco support and request a postmortem. Ticket created: OBSCO-7891.
jamal: Reached out to vendor via support@obsco.example with correlation logs and request for expedited mitigation.
tia_oncall: Handoff: I'm going offline for 30m to restack and hand to eng-sre (maya) for monitoring during vendor response. maya, you're primary.
maya: Taking over. Will keep the channel updated. If we see >1% errors again, escalate to SEV-1.
eng-sre: Noted. Also creating a metric alert for control-plane validation error rate.
alex: Quick note for post-incident: 1) implement local fallback earlier in control-plane 2) add exponential backoff jitter when vendor 5xxs happen to avoid coordinated reprogramming 3) document a 'validation bypass' playbook in runbooks.
customer-success: Customers acknowledged the mitigation. Two reported transient errors are now resolved. One customer (tenant-101) still seeing occasional 502s, investigating.
deploy-bot: Rolling restart complete. Controller pods on new config healthy.
maya: Vendor reports partial fix deployed but still degraded. Monitoring for 30m.
jamal: Logs show final stabilization at ~11:36 UTC. Error rate back to 0.07%.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0452 status: Mitigated -> monitoring.
tia_oncall: Back on. Thanks maya. I'll join the postmortem.
alex: P1 summary for incident notes (to paste into postmortem): "Third-party observability API returned intermittent 5xx responses during control-plane route validation, causing controller retries and ILB route churn for Private VPC cross-region deployments. Immediate mitigation: flipped obsco validation to fallback mode, applied local-first routing for affected tenants, paused non-critical forwarding-rule updates. Impact: brief spike to 3.2% 502s for cross-region Private VPC traffic, 3 tenants affected, no data loss. Follow-ups: vendor postmortem requested, add hardened fallback + jitter, runbook update."
eng-sre: I'll create the postmortem doc and link ticket OBSCO-7891. Assigning follow-ups to oncall rotation.
customer-success: Customers marked as "remediated" pending vendor postmortem.
ops-bot: Reminder: run the incident retro template: /templates/incident-retro.md
alex: Thanks team. Closing channel for operational chatter. Keep this thread for notes and PSIs.
